name: Moriroku Company, Ltd.
summary: Moriroku Company, Ltd. engages in the resin-processed products and chemicals businesses in Japan. The company offers automotive exterior and interior parts, motorcycle exterior parts; and decoration variation, such as painting, hot stamping, multilayer molding and in-mold decoration, as well as sticks and film sheets. It also sells, imports, and exports chemicals, synthetic resin products; and functional components. The company was formerly known as Moriroku Holdings Company, Ltd. and changed its name to Moriroku Company, Ltd. in March 2025. Moriroku Company, Ltd. was founded in 1663 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
